verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM offers automation-like features such as Agent Flows and custom agent workflows, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents versioning, change review, history, or rollback for those automations. Mentions of agent flows and custom skills show that automations exist, not that they can be versioned or rolled back.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
